rule.statement: The presumption found in Section 114 (d) of the Evidence Ordinance has to be drawn, namely the official act of alienation of the grant has been regularly performed.
rule.supporting_quote: 29. I take the view that in such a situation, the presumption found in Section 114 (d) of the Evidence Ordinance has to be drawn, namely the official act of alienation of the grant has been regularly performed.
